name: vercel-deploy-fail
prompt: Vercel deploy failed. Project: {payload.deployment.name}. Commit: {payload.deployment.meta.githubCommitSha}. Error: pull the build logs via vercel-deploys skill. Identify the failing step. If it's a known transient (network, npm registry hiccup): suggest a retry. If it's a real failure (build error, test fail, type error): identify the PR that introduced it via gh and post a failure summary to #alerts with: failing step, likely cause, and either retry-command or rollback-suggestion per business/sops/engineering/deploy-rollback.md.
